data.description:
testing_mode: RED

Write failing tests for the schema migration script that rebuilds the SNAPSHOT. Tests must be RED before T14 implementation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given: migration script called with --dry-run; When: executed; Then: exits 0, prints 'DRY_RUN: would bump schema_version to N', modifies no files
- Given: migration script called without flags; When: executed; Then: creates a pre-migration SNAPSHOT backup file before any modification (backup filename includes a timestamp)
- Given: migration completed; When: SNAPSHOT.json parsed; Then: contains schema_version field with bumped integer value
- Given: migration completed and backup exists; When: script called with --rollback; Then: backup restored to SNAPSHOT.json, exits 0
- Given: events replayed from scratch after migration; When: resulting ticket states compared to pre-migration backup; Then: all ticket IDs, statuses, and field values match (no data loss)

Test file: tests/scripts/test-ticket-migration.sh (new file — executable bit required)
depends_on: T11 (d497-8774), T13 (b25c-1e73)
Story DD coverage: SC6, SC7 (schema migration safety)
Retry budget: 2 attempts
data.title: RED: tests for SNAPSHOT rebuild migration (dry-run, backup, rollback)
